refusedBeyondOverride: {{action}} was refused, and nothing was changed, because it could cut Nexara off from the cluster. To go ahead anyway, do it again and confirm the override that is then offered.

selfCredential.warning: Nexara can lose access to this cluster, or some of what it may do there. If it does, the cluster shows as unreachable or actions fail until you update its credentials in Nexara or undo the change in Proxmox.

tokenSecret.title: API token created
tokenSecret.copyNow: Copy this secret now. Proxmox shows it only once — there is no way to retrieve it later, and recovering from a lost secret means regenerating the token.
tokenSecret.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the secret above and copy it manually (Ctrl+C).

realms.title: Authentication realms
realms.intro: Editing a realm needs the Realm.Allocate privilege, which only the Administrator role carries. Manage realms in the Proxmox UI under Datacenter → Permissions → Realms.

groups.title: Groups
groups.aside_one: {{count}} group. Open a group to see its members.
groups.aside_other: {{count}} groups. Open a group to see its members.
groups.deleteDescription: Members keep their accounts, but lose any permissions granted through this group. This cannot be undone.
groups.deleteConflictTitle: Deleting this group can cut off Nexara's access

roles.title: Roles
roles.readOnly: Read-only: Nexara's token lacks Sys.Modify on /access, which Proxmox requires to manage roles.
roles.editorDescription: Privileges are read from this cluster, so the list matches its Proxmox version.
roles.selectedNoneWarning: {{n}} selected<warn> — saving with none selected removes every privilege from this role.</warn>
roles.saveConflictTitle: Saving this role can cut off Nexara's access
roles.deleteDescription: Any user or token holding this role loses the permissions it grants, immediately. This cannot be undone.
roles.deleteConflictTitle: Deleting this role can cut off Nexara's access

acl.title: Permissions
acl.aside_one: {{count}} entry: a role held by a user, group or token on a path
acl.aside_other: {{count}} entries: a role held by a user, group or token on a path
acl.grantDescription: Assigns a role to a user, group or token on an ACL path.
acl.grantConflictTitle: Granting this can cut off Nexara's access
acl.subject: Subject
acl.revokeConflictTitle: Revoking this can cut off Nexara's access

users.title: Users
users.aside_one: {{count}} user. Open a user to see its API tokens.
users.aside_other: {{count}} users. Open a user to see its API tokens.
users.asideDisabled_one: {{count}} user, {{disabled}} disabled. Open a user to see its API tokens.
users.asideDisabled_other: {{count}} users, {{disabled}} disabled. Open a user to see its API tokens.
users.createDescription: Users are created on the cluster itself, not in Nexara.
users.passwordHint: Leave empty for a token-only account that cannot log in interactively.
users.deleteDescription: This removes the Proxmox user and every API token it owns. Anything authenticating with one of those tokens loses access immediately, and the secrets cannot be recovered. This cannot be undone.
users.deleteConflictTitle: Deleting this user can cut off Nexara's access
users.groupsHint: Groups: {{groups}} — edit these in the Proxmox UI.
users.loadFailedStale: {{error}} — showing the details as last read.
users.saveConflictTitle: Saving this edit can cut off Nexara's access

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.none: No API tokens for this user.
tokens.revokeDescription: Anything authenticating with this token loses access immediately. The secret cannot be recovered — a replacement has to be created and distributed.
tokens.regenerateDescription: A new secret is issued and the current one stops working immediately. The new secret is shown once and cannot be retrieved afterwards.
tokens.revokeConflictTitle: Revoking this token can cut off Nexara's access
tokens.regenerateConflictTitle: Regenerating this token can cut off Nexara's access
tokens.regeneratedSecretNotShown: Regenerated the API token {{token}}, but its new secret could not be shown because this view was closed. The old secret no longer works, and Proxmox shows a secret only once: regenerate the token again to get a new one.
tokens.createdSecretNotShown: Created the API token {{token}}, but its secret could not be shown because this view was closed. Proxmox shows a secret only once: regenerate the token to get a new one.
